Recordings adapted for faster game playback: MP3 audio re-encoded at 128 kbps;
1.50 seconds of opening silence removed from Decisions and 1.26 seconds from
Lost Frontier, with a short fade to avoid clicks. Original music is otherwise
retained. In-game playback loops, crossfades, adjusts volume and ducks the
music under battle effects.

Click: Interface Sounds by Kenney
Dice shake and landing: Casino Audio by Kenney
Footsteps and impact: Impact Sounds by Kenney
https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
https://kenney.nl/assets/casino-audio
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds

Original pack license notices are included beside this file.

Missile whoosh and musical notification, capture, reinforcement, victory,
defeat and invalid-action cues are original procedural Web Audio effects
created for this project. No external service or API key is required.
